title: GET/PUT /api/v1/me/notifications
description: The signed-in person's email preferences in the tenant they work in (m1_091). weekly_digest is the opt-in weekly savings email, false until turned on; PUT takes {weekly_digest} and answers this shape. email is where it goes (the sign-in's address). Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe link (public GET/POST /api/v1/unsubscribe/{token}).
